Maya (Product): @channel quick heads-up: tomorrow 09:30 PT we GA Conversational Stream v3 for hosted customers. v3 unifies streaming, structured-output markers, and improved backpressure handling. This is opt-in and backwards-compatible. Read the short rollout notes below.

Ibrahim (Eng): Any surface changes clients need to opt in?

Maya (Product): Opt-in via header `X-ConvStream: v3` or `?conv=v3`. No required payload changes. Example: `curl -H "X-ConvStream: v3" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"mosaicx-conv","input":"Summarize today's meeting","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

Rita (Docs): Docs PR is ready: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4722  includes migration guide, quick diffs, and SDK snippets for node/python. I'll publish at go-time.

Celeste (SRE): Ops: canary path us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> ap-southeast-1, 30m windows. Abort if p95 rises +40% or error rate >1.7x. Fallback: auto-route affected keys to `/v0/convstream` for 12m. Runbook pinned: https://runbooks.redwood/convstream-v3.

Nikhil (ML): Note on quality: v3 reduces token stuttering for structured outputs and improves tool-call synchronization. Eval hooks show no regression; slight latency win for short-turns (~6%). We'll watch function-call alignment metrics.

Ibrahim (Eng): Any changes to function-calling payloads?

Maya (Product): No changes to schema. v3 adds `structured_marker` streaming events but preserves existing `tools` and `tool_call` semantics. SDKs will add a `convStreamVersion: "v3"` option.

Celeste (SRE): DeployBot scheduled job cs3-197800. Canary starting will post logs.

DeployBot: Job cs3-197800 scheduled starting 2026-03-27T16:30:00Z. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/cs3-197800/logs

Celeste (SRE): Canary +8m: p50 95ms, errors flat. Proceeding to next region.

Maya (Product): Action items: Eng/SRE watch canary and be ready to rollback in first 20m; Docs publish migration note; ML monitor eval hooks for tool alignment. I'll post GA summary and initial metrics after 48h.

Ibrahim (Eng): :thumbsup: I'll monitor dashboards.

DeployBot: Canary complete: succeeded. Starting global rollout.

Celeste (SRE): Global rollout complete, no aborts. Closing monitoring window in 15m.

Maya (Product): Thank you team. We'll follow up with cost/latency impact and customer outreach plan.
